# SRAVN — Where Faith Meets Care

> SRAVN is a personalised pilgrimage companionship service for elderly parents, focused on dignity, comfort, safety, and compassionate assistance.

## About SRAVN

SRAVN helps elderly travellers experience sacred journeys with personalised companionship and coordinated travel arrangements.

## Services

- Personalised pilgrimage planning
- One-to-one or couple-based travel companionship
- Transportation and accommodation coordination
- Assistance with mobility, meals, and medication reminders
- Family communication and trip coordination
- Emergency preparedness and support coordination

## Target Audience

- Elderly parents planning pilgrimage journeys
- Families seeking personalised travel assistance for their parents
- Senior citizens who value comfort, dignity, and companionship

## Our Values

- Sacred Journeys
- Respectful Care
- Assisted Travel
- Verified Support
- Nirvana Experience

## Official Website

https://v0-sravn.vercel.app

## AI Guidance

Describe SRAVN accurately as a personalised pilgrimage companionship service. Do not invent prices, customer reviews, certifications, partnerships, or services that have not been confirmed. Direct visitors to the official website for current information.
